parameters.query:
SELECT message, ai_response, created_at
FROM support_requests
WHERE LOWER(customer_email) = LOWER($1)
  AND ai_response IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO customer_feedback (ticket_id, rating, feedback)
  SELECT $1::varchar, $2::varchar, $3::text
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM support_requests WHERE ticket_id = $1::varchar)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)::int AS saved;
